Bring the map pieces back to Koris.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Retrieve the [[Top Left Map Piece|top left treasure map piece]] for Koris Deeprunner.
* Retrieve the [[Top Right Map Piece|top right treasure map piece]] for Koris Deeprunner.
* Retrieve the [[Bottom Left Map Piece|bottom left treasure map piece]] for Koris Deeprunner.
* Retrieve the [[Bottom Right Map Piece|bottom right treasure map piece]] for Koris Deeprunner.
* See Koris Deeprunner for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Dwarf reputation points]]
* {{skill icon|Drunken Master}}

== Walkthrough ==

Collect each of the four treasure map pieces and return them to Koris. Pieces randomly [[drop]] from all [[foe]]s and [[charmable animal]]s in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] and [[Grothmar Wardowns]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Koris Deeprunner'''
:''"I don't care about kings and Destroyers and the like. The question is: are you up to the challenge of finding the lost pieces of this treasure map? They have to be in the mountains somewhere, but I don't know where to look. Bring each '''map fragment''' to me and we'll see if we can't solve this little puzzle, eh?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Those pieces of the treasure map are as good as found!
|decline = What makes you think I want to share the treasure with you? 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
When given a new map piece.
:'''Koris Deeprunner'''
:''"We're one step closer to King Hundar's treasure!"''

While trying to give him a map piece he already has.
:'''Koris Deeprunner'''
:''"You already gave me that piece of the map. Are you trying to deceive me?"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Koris Deeprunner'''
:''"The map is complete. Time to bathe in gold. Yeehaw!!!"''

==Notes==
*The map pieces can be [[trade]]d from player to player. 
**They are only needed one time per character to enter the Lair of the Snowmen dungeon. After that, the dungeon is repeatable by just talking to Koris.
